notes.title: First Major Update - World 6 Added!
notes.content:
The journey of Lost & Round has just begun! With the first major update added to the game, players can expect new and devious levels to kick off the start of Chapter 2. Explore World 6: The Neonosphere and traverse the dark and dreamy Neozone to grab one more Megapixel on your journey. With the addition of +10 more levels, the current price for Lost & Round will be increased to $5.99 USD to reflect the level of content currently available in-game. Thank you to everyone who has enjoyed my little game so far, and I am excited to bring this and future updates to the Community!

One Love,
-Jimmy (Open Sky Studios)

notes.title: Lost & Round - First Patch Released!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has purchased Lost & Round so far--your support means the world to me! Thanks to the excellent feedback of some early players, the following features have been implemented:

[olist]
 Ability to skip the Intro cutscene has been added.
 Additional options for rotating the camera with Q and E keys.
 Dialog can now be advanced with the F key (or the Continue button).
[/olist]
Bug Note: I am aware of a UI issue with the Yes/No buttons on the 'New Game' screen. I have listed a workaround in-game and am in search of a fix!
